purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Cherkasy

queries.query: Cherkasy Ukraine official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Cherkasy regional StateGeoCadastre site and the official Cherkasy municipal GIS department page linking the municipal urban-cadastre geoportal. The municipal ArcGIS service exposed a polygon layer and returned three bounded parcel-like polygons anonymously.

queries.query: Черкаси офіційна кадастрова карта земельний кадастр геопортал
queries.result: Found the first-party Cherkasy regional StateGeoCadastre cadastral-and-registration page and the Cherkasy city department page. The city page identifies the urban-cadastre GIS function and links the official municipal geoportal; its ArcGIS layer returned bounded parcel polygons.

registryEvidence.basis: The first-party Cherkasy regional StateGeoCadastre site documents the State Land Cadastre and cadastral registration, while the Cherkasy municipal department page identifies the city urban-cadastre GIS function and links the municipal geoportal. The linked municipal ArcGIS layer produced a bounded anonymous polygon response.

officialSources.observation: Official Cherkasy regional StateGeoCadastre page describes the State Land Cadastre and cadastral-number registration.
Official Cherkasy city department page identifies the urban-cadastre GIS function and links the city geoportal.
Official municipal ArcGIS Feature Layer named 'Внутрішні території 1:2257'; polygon geometry, cadastral-number field, and source CRS msk_Cherkassy/Pulkovo 1942 are exposed.

source.name: Cherkasy municipal GIS Landuse_update_WGS84 / layer 52
source.operator: Cherkasy City Council municipal GIS / Department of Architecture and Urban Planning
source.scope: Municipal Cherkasy urban-cadastre layer; observed extent is city-focused and not evidence of Ukraine-wide coverage.
source.nativeIdentity: cdstr_nmbr (alias: Кадастровий номер); objectid and globalid also exist but were not requested
source.reuseStatus: Open anonymous read observed; licence or reuse terms for the feature layer were not independently established. Runtime admission remains held pending serial review.

requests.assessment: First-party municipal department page loaded and linked the city geoportal.
Layer schema read anonymously; polygon geometry, fields, native CRS and extent observed. Unsafe fields were not requested in the feature query.
Exact WUP point query returned zero features; this is not treated as a coverage-negative result.
Bounded 3857 envelope around the city point, resultRecordCount=3, outFields=cdstr_nmbr, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326 returned three full parcel polygons; response reported exceededTransferLimit.

unsafeFieldsNotRequested: source fields such as master, users, property, doc_justce

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Cherkasy municipal urban-cadastre GIS layer; regional StateGeoCadastre is a separate custodian/procedure source.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous parcel polygon response verified for a bounded area within the municipal service extent; not citywide completeness and not countrywide coverage.

qualification.reason: A real bounded ID+geometry response was verified, but adapter admission, completeness, and reuse/licence qualification remain for serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point returned zero features and was not shifted; the successful bounded query is the evidence of local service availability.
The municipal layer's min/max scale and observed extent do not establish complete city coverage.
The regional StateGeoCadastre pages establish a local custodian and procedures but do not themselves provide the parcel polygons used in the sample.
The ArcGIS response exceeded its three-record transfer limit; no larger response was retained.
uncertainty: The municipal service clearly exposes polygon geometry and stable cadastral-number identities in a bounded anonymous read. Completeness across Cherkasy, currentness, formal reuse terms, and whether the municipal layer represents all cadastral parcels remain unresolved. This packet is research evidence only and does not constitute source integration or admission.
